title: Re-opening page search keeps the last typed text and its results
permissions_required: Any signed-in user of the ShopView App. Whether search results are scoped by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. Some sample work orders, customers, assets, parts and vendors exist.
steps: 1. Open the page search and type a term (for example 'Fibridge').
2. Close the panel, then open it again.
3. Look at the search box and the results.
expected: 1. The previous search text is still in the box (shown selected/highlighted) and its results are shown.

2. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (whether the last search is remembered per person and for how long — this is the 'persisting search' state).
notes: Design-only (persisting-search state). Persistence scope pending confirmation.
